subject: Transportation Systems
title: Microtransit and On-Demand Rides
description: Learn Microtransit and On-Demand Rides in one minute.

hook.text: Fixed-route buses don't work everywhere. Some neighborhoods are too spread out for regular service.

buildup.text: Microtransit uses small vans that pick up riders on demand, routing flexibly like a shared Uber.

discovery.text: Apps let riders request a pickup. The system groups nearby requests and generates an efficient route.

twist.text: Per-rider costs are much higher than fixed-route buses. Microtransit works in low-demand zones, not busy ones.

climax.text: Arlington, Texas replaced its bus system entirely with on-demand microtransit. Results are still debated.

punchline.text: Fixed routes serve crowds. Flexible vans serve gaps.

quiz.question: Where does microtransit work best?
options: Low-demand suburban areas poorly served by fixed routes
